test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the sentence that uses the given idiom correctly.

Have your head in the clouds

options.text: He had his head in the clouds during an important meeting.
The pilot had his head in the clouds while flying a plane.
They had their heads in the clouds by looking up at the sky during a meteor shower.
She had her head in the clouds by wearing a cloud-shaped hat.

solution: The correct answer is **Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Have your head in the clouds"** means** to be daydreaming or not paying attention to what is happening around you. (**ख्याली पुलाव पकाना) • **Example: **He always has his head in the clouds, thinking about his next vacation instead of focusing on work. • **Correct usage:** The idiom is correctly used when describing someone who is not paying attention or is lost in their thoughts. (सही उपयोग) • **Example: **She had her head in the clouds during the lecture and missed important points. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2:** The pilot had his head in the clouds while flying a plane. (पायलट ने एक विमान उड़ाते समय ख्याली पुलाव पकाया हुआ था।) • **Explanation:** This is incorrect because a pilot should not be daydreaming while flying a plane; it implies negligence. • **Option 3:** They had their heads in the clouds by looking up at the sky during a meteor shower. (वे उल्का बौछार के दौरान आकाश को देखते हुए ख्याली पुलाव पका रहे थे।) • **Explanation:** This is incorrect because the idiom is not about literally looking at the sky; it's about being lost in thoughts. • **Option 4:** She had her head in the clouds by wearing a cloud-shaped hat. (उसने बादल के आकार की टोपी पहनकर ख्याली पुलाव पकाया।) • **Explanation:** This is incorrect because the idiom has nothing to do with wearing a cloud-shaped hat; it’s about daydreaming. 3d3:Tcd2, The correct answer is **Option 1)**
